errors.text_span: дела на запазените при тях работни места
errors.evidence: The description simplifies the Y-axis label, which is 'Запазени работни места - кумулативна относителна честота (%)' (Retained jobs - cumulative relative frequency (%)). Omitting the 'cumulative relative frequency' part is a significant error as it misrepresents the nature of the data being plotted.

errors.text_span: има форма на дъга с постепенен наклон
errors.evidence: Describing the slope as 'gradual' is a major over-generalization. The key feature of the curve is its very steep initial slope which then flattens dramatically, indicating a high concentration. 'Gradual' misrepresents this.
The line on the plot does not end at (100%, 100%). It reaches the maximum Y-value of 100% well before the X-axis value reaches 100%, and the data does not extend to the right edge of the chart.
